items.source_summary: The author tracked 60 SPX iron condor fills against the displayed mid price and found consistent execution at $0.15–$0.25 below the displayed mid on 4-leg spreads showing a mid of ~$2.80, causing actual returns to run 15–20% below model projections. The discrepancy persisted across all DTE, strike, and delta adjustments, indicating the problem is systematic execution friction rather than strategy construction.
items.sofar_gap_analysis: SOFAR's backcheck-predictions.sh validates predictions by comparing predicted price levels to actual Yahoo Finance closing prices, using midpoint prices as the execution assumption for any trade ideas generated by ai-synthesis.py. The source demonstrates a systematic $0.15–$0.25 per-spread gap between displayed mid and actual fills on SPX iron condors. If SOFAR's ai-synthesis.py generates SPX multi-leg options trade ideas with price targets derived from mid prices, those targets are systematically optimistic by this fill-slippage amount. backcheck-score.py's price accuracy grading would misattribute fill slippage as model error, inflating the apparent price error of correctly-directioned trade ideas and contaminating signal attribution in attribution-calibration.json.

proposed_change.change_description: Add a fill_slippage_assumption field to accuracy-log.json entries for multi-leg SPX options trade ideas: default value -0.20 (cents per dollar notional, representing the $0.15–$0.25 midpoint). When scoring price accuracy for SPX iron condor or multi-leg spread trade ideas in backcheck-predictions.sh, apply slippage_adjusted_predicted_price = predicted_price - fill_slippage_assumption before computing price error vs actual. Store both unadjusted_predicted_price and slippage_adjusted_predicted_price in the log entry. This separates model error from execution friction in accuracy-stats.json signal attribution.

items.evidence_basis: Empirical first-person dataset of exactly 60 SPX iron condor fills with specific numeric bounds ($0.15–$0.25) and consistent direction. Reddit engagement score 100 with 66 comments indicates community validation. Named author u/MilesDelta with reproducible methodology.

items.title: Quantpedia: pro-cyclical strategies synchronize in crises; crisis hedges needed
items.source_summary: The article states that most systematic trading strategies are pro-cyclical, performing best in trending low-volatility markets, and that during crises correlations increase, volatility spikes, and traditional diversification weakens, causing simultaneous drawdowns. The article's observation that pro-cyclical signals fail simultaneously during explosive regimes maps directly to this gap: SOFAR cannot currently determine whether its prediction accuracy degrades specifically during explosive vol regimes. The self-calibration system in ai-synthesis.py injects the last 10 resolved predictions but has no regime-stratified weighting — a cluster of explosive-regime mispredictions is diluted by routine low-vol-regime correct calls.

Add worst_regime and best_regime fields at the accuracy-stats.json top level for direct injection into ai-synthesis.py calibration prompt.

items.title: Quantpedia: thinly traded alternative ETFs exhibit short-term reversal from limited liquidity
items.source_summary: The article argues that alternative ETFs packaging managed futures, merger arbitrage, and option-based income strategies are thinly traded relative to mainstream ETFs, and that this limited liquidity creates potential for short-term reversal strategies and exposure to alternative risk premia. Source is truncated before methodology or results are described.
items.sofar_gap_analysis: SOFAR's fetch-options-flow.sh applies a uniform $25k minimum premium filter across all symbols and its unusual activity detector uses a >2× average premium threshold. Option-based income ETFs (e.g., JEPI, JEPQ, QYLD) are thinly traded — a $25k flow in these products represents a proportionally larger position signal than in SPY. SOFAR has no relative volume normalization: the same absolute premium threshold that catches noise in liquid SPY options may capture genuinely unusual institutional positioning in thinly traded options ETFs. The reversal dynamic the article describes is driven by this exact liquidity asymmetry.

proposed_change.change_description: Create data/flow-baselines.json storing a rolling 30-day average daily premium per symbol, updated each fetch run. In fetch-options-flow.sh, compute relative_premium_ratio = trade_premium / flow_baselines[symbol].avg_daily_premium for each trade (default 1.0 if symbol not yet baselined). Add relative_premium_ratio to each trade entry in options-flow.json. Flag trades with relative_premium_ratio > 3.0 as unusual_activity_type: 'relative_spike' regardless of absolute dollar size, in addition to the existing absolute-threshold unusual activity flag.

items.title: Quantpedia: calendar strategies add portfolio diversification not visible in isolation
items.source_summary: The article argues that calendar strategies appear weak when evaluated individually due to low annualized returns and sparse trading, but that their primary value is as portfolio components where structural properties provide diversification benefits not visible in standalone evaluation. items.sofar_gap_analysis: SOFAR's backcheck-predictions.sh evaluates each prediction independently and signal attribution in attribution-calibration.json scores each of the 8 input signals in isolation. The article's methodological point — that strategies evaluated independently understate their portfolio-level contribution — maps to a real gap: two SOFAR signals that individually score 55% directional accuracy but have negatively correlated errors would have combined predictive value exceeding their individual scores, but attribution-calibration.json has no cross-signal error correlation matrix. SOFAR may be underweighting signal combinations that are individually unremarkable but jointly predictive.

Store as a symmetric 8×8 matrix under 'signal_pair_correlations' in attribution-calibration.json. Compute and store 'best_complement_pair' as the pair with the most negative error correlation. Inject into ai-synthesis.py prompt as 'SIGNAL_COMPLEMENT: {signal_a} and {signal_b} have most negatively correlated errors — weight joint agreement above either alone.'
